description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from Quaker Oats website, including metadata, ingredients, instructions, and other recipe details.

classes.name: QuakerOats
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from Quaker Oats website.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author of the recipe, 'The Quaker Oats Company'.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the recipe title from the HTML.

methods.name: _get_metadata_from_span
methods.description: Helper method to extract metadata from span elements by partial ID.

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Extracts preparation time in minutes from the HTML.

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Extracts cooking time in minutes from the HTML.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Extracts the number of servings or yield from the recipe.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total time by summing prep and cook times.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts list of ingredients with quantities from the HTML.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients based on HTML structure.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts and joins recipe instructions steps.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Extracts the meta description of the recipe.
